text: The purpose of this report is to provide information on the purchase of service contracts awarded and executed by the Medical Officer of Health for 2024, according to the delegation of authority by City Council. This report also requests approval for the Medical Officer of Health to award, execute and amend, on an ongoing basis, purchase of services contracts with Working Women Community Centre to deliver food handler training and certification, food literacy, and employment skills development to low-income community participants, including newcomers and refugees.

City Council on June 26 and 27, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the Medical Officer of Health to award, execute, and amend, on an ongoing basis, purchase of service agreements for food security initiatives with Working Women Community Centre, within the approved Toronto Public Health budget, in accordance with applicable program and funding guidelines, on terms and conditions satisfactory to the Medical Officer of Health and in a form approved by the City Solicitor.
